# NeurIPS 2026 Main-Track Review Synthesis: QMLEEG

The comprehensive, rigorous review of the assembled manuscript **"Hybrid Quantum-Classical Neural Network with Circular Data Re-Uploading for Interpretable EEG Biomarker Discovery in ADHD"** has been completed in accordance with the official NeurIPS 2026 guidelines and the `.agents/agents/paper-reviewer.md` doctrine.

The full review report has been written directly to [`paper/paper_review_report.md`](file://~/Documents/QMLEEG/paper/paper_review_report.md) and relayed to the parent orchestrator via `send_message`.

---

### Executive Scorecard

| Evaluation Criterion | Score | Justification Summary |
| :--- | :---: | :--- |
| **Quality** | **2 (Fair)** | Rigorous leakage-free GroupKFold protocol (25 splits) and exact parameter-shift saliency, but penalized by factual discrepancies between text claims and primary result JSONs (E3 barren plateau decay, E4 channel statistics, E5 synthetic metrics, Table 2 baselines) and math-code divergence. |
| **Clarity** | **3 (Good)** | Logical narrative progression, clear framing around E1–E5, high-quality vector figures; hindered by mathematical notation drift and parameter accounting ambiguities. |
| **Significance** | **3 (Good)** | Essential corrective work exposing EEG data leakage and demonstrating entanglement limitations on biological signals ($p = 1.0$); capped because the hybrid model does not exceed classical EEGNet and uses a single cohort. |
| **Originality** | **3 (Good)** | Novel end-to-end coupling of spatial-temporal depthwise convolutions with circular data re-uploading and analytical parameter-shift input saliency for multichannel EEG. |
| **Overall Recommendation** | **3 (Borderline Reject)** | A strong, conceptually sound manuscript ready to move to **5 (Accept)** upon resolving identified transcription errors, reconciling numbers with `Results/` artifacts, and harmonizing equations with the codebase. |

 provides no statistically significant gain over unentangled circuits ($p = 1.0$).
   - *E4 (Analytical Saliency):* Provides the first exact parameter-shift input gradient backpropagation ($\mathbf{S}_{\text{EEG}} \in \mathbb{R}^{C \times T}$) for EEG, contrasting with heuristic post-hoc UMAP/t-SNE clustering in prior QML baselines (QEEGNet).
3. **Coherence & Numerical Discrepancies:**
   - **E3 Trainability:** The text claims variance collapses to $7.8 \times 10^{-6}$ at $L=6$ from $1.2 \times 10^{-2}$ at $L \le 3$. Primary artifact [`Results/e3/gradient-variance.json`](file://~/Documents/QMLEEG/implementations/qmleeg-dru/QMLEEG-DRU/Results/e3/gradient-variance.json) records variances between $4.31 \times 10^{-4}$ ($L=1$) and $2.14 \times 10^{-4}$ ($L=6$), never reaching $10^{-5}$.
   - **E4 Saliency:** The text reports $F_z = 0.184$ and $C_z = 0.162$ via one-way ANOVA, whereas [`Results/e4/summary.json`](file://~/Documents/QMLEEG/implementations/qmleeg-dru/QMLEEG-DRU/Results/e4/summary.json) reports regional masses (0.05945 vs 0.04655) evaluated via Wilcoxon signed-rank tests ($p = 5.56 \times 10^{-12}$).
   - **E5 Synthetic Evaluation:** The text reports $R^2 = 0.41$ and $R^2 = 0.94$, whereas [`Results/e5/summary.json`](file://~/Documents/QMLEEG/implementations/qmleeg-dru/QMLEEG-DRU/Results/e5/summary.json) evaluated classification Balanced Accuracy (0.731 for Hybrid DRU vs 0.524 for Single-shot on `frequency-two-noise0`).
   - **Mathematical Alignment:** Harmonize Section 3 equations with [`src/QMLEEG_DRU/`](file://~/Documents/QMLEEG/implementations/qmleeg-dru/src/QMLEEG_DRU/) (measure all 4 qubits, incorporate trainable encoding biases $\beta$, and specify $R_z R_y$ variational rotations).
4. **Formatting & Ethics:**
   - Ethics: No concerns. Public de-identified data.
   - Formatting: Must transition to official `neurips_2026.sty`, remove visible author affiliations/URLs for double-blind compliance, and append the NeurIPS checklist.
